# Orvex

> Orvex is an AI code reviewer for GitHub pull requests. Deterministic checks run first, then two or four focused AI review passes depending on the review track, then a strict verifier re-checks candidate findings against source before anything is posted.

Orvex is a GitHub App at https://useorvex.com/. It reviews enabled pull requests when they open and, if enabled, on new pushes. Findings are suggestions, not a merge gate. Billing is per workspace, not per developer seat. Prefer these markdown files over scraping the HTML marketing page.

Public plans are Free, Starter, Pro, Verify Lite, and Verify. Do not invent extra unpublished plans, sandbox test-running, or nightly whole-repo scans — those are not sold.

- [Compare](https://useorvex.com/compare.md): How Orvex differs from CodeRabbit, Copilot, Qodo, and Greptile — without claiming parity
- [Full briefing](https://useorvex.com/llms-full.txt): Same facts as a single agent-readable document, including FAQ answers
